performance.verdict: GBP is collapsing; organic the only channel — zero paid activity distorts score.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days; CPL is undefined. No Meta, Google, or paid channel is active — there is nothing to efficiency-rate.
GBP actions dropped 76.92% last 7d vs prior 7d. 3-day signal (Sep 11–13) = 0 actions vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10) = 3 actions — confirms collapse, not noise.
Search clicks fell 35.71% (7d delta); last 3 days (Sep 11–13) = 3 clicks vs prior 3 (Sep 8–10) = 5 clicks. Organic search visibility is also softening.
GA4 sessions dropped 48.44% (7d delta); last 3 days (Sep 11–13) = 11 sessions vs prior 3 (Sep 8–10) = 18 sessions — corroborates declining inbound interest across all touchpoints.
GBP call rate is 0.59% against 341 impressions (28d). Even when GBP was active, calls were nearly absent — 2 calls total — suggesting profile or offer friction pre-dates the current drop.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions daily for 3 more days; re-check Sep 17 before any profile intervention.
